user.title: Connect Murf AI
user.description: Enter your Murf API key. You can create one in the [Murf API dashboard]({api_key_url}).

data_description.api_key: Key from the Murf API dashboard (not your login password).
data_description.region: Where speech is generated. 'Global' routes to the nearest server; a fixed region keeps the data in that region.

reauth_confirm.title: Murf API key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: Murf no longer accepts the stored API key. Enter a new key from the [Murf API dashboard]({api_key_url}).

reconfigure.title: Change Murf account settings
reconfigure.description: Change the API key or the region. Keys are managed in the [Murf API dashboard]({api_key_url}).

error.cannot_connect: Murf could not be reached. Check the network connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The API key has been updated.

language.title: Language and model
language.description: Choose the language the voice should speak and the Murf model.

data_description.model: Falcon is fast and made for real-time use. Gen2 has the most natural sound but more latency.

settings.title: Voice settings
settings.description: Settings for {voice} in {language}. Style, speed and pitch can also be overridden per call.

data_description.name: Name of the TTS entity in Home Assistant.
data_description.rate: -50 (slow) to 50 (fast), 0 is the voice's normal speed.
data_description.pitch: -50 (low) to 50 (high), 0 is the voice's normal pitch.
data_description.audio_format: MP3 works with nearly every media player.

error.no_voices_for_language: The selected model has no voice for this language. Choose another model or language.
error.invalid_voice: Choose a voice from the list.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The Murf integration is not loaded. Fix the account first, then add voices.
abort.cannot_connect: The voice list could not be loaded from Murf.
abort.no_voices: Murf did not return any voices.

invalid_auth.message: Murf rejected the API key. Re-authenticate the integration.

quota_exceeded.message: The Murf account has no characters left or the plan does not allow this request: {error}

invalid_number.message: Option {option} must be a whole number between {min} and {max}.
